title: Octopuses Are Basically Aliens

scenes.narration: An octopus has three hearts, and one of them stops when it swims.
scenes.image_prompt: an orange octopus swimming through clear blue water, arms trailing behind it

scenes.narration: Its blood is blue, because it carries oxygen with copper instead of iron.
scenes.image_prompt: deep blue ocean water with shafts of sunlight and a small octopus silhouette

scenes.narration: Most of its neurons are not in its head. They are spread through its eight arms.
scenes.image_prompt: a curled octopus arm on a rock, detailed suckers, underwater

scenes.narration: Each arm can taste what it touches, using thousands of sensors in its suckers.
scenes.image_prompt: macro photo of octopus suckers touching a seashell

scenes.narration: And it changes color in a split second to vanish against the reef.
scenes.image_prompt: a camouflaged octopus blending into a colourful coral reef

scenes.narration: Which fact surprised you most? Follow for more.
scenes.image_prompt: a curious octopus peeking out of a coral reef, looking at the camera

description: Three hearts, blue blood and arms that can taste. The octopus might be the strangest animal on Earth. Which fact surprised you most?
